w:r.w:t: The purpose and scope of this Proof of Value (PoV) is to demonstrate the capabilities of OPSWAT’s MetaDefender Managed File Transfer (MFT) solution within your specific environment. The primary objectives are to verify the solution's effectiveness in securely transferring files while scanning for malware.

Performance benchmarking. This is due to a number of variables that affect performance (file set, networking configurations, hardware characteristics). OPSWAT will review the performance metrics from the test and advise if any improvements need to be made and where.
Verify the solution's effectiveness in malware and Zero Day detection.
Assess the capabilities of Deep Content Disarm and Reconstruction (CDR).
Ensure the solution meets the predefined success criteria.
Ease of integration with existing infrastructure.
Compatibility with various operating systems and environments.
API availability and ease of use for custom integrations.
Speed and accuracy of malware detection.
Support for a wide range of file types and archives.
Effectiveness in detecting advanced threats and zero-day vulnerabilities.
Adherence to industry standards and regulations.
Ability to support data privacy and protection requirements.
Comprehensive report on performance against success criteria.
